card.text: Hot Saturn-mass giant, 1.28 Jupiter radii, that circles its star every 4 days.

introduction.text: WASP-39 b is a puffy gas giant 1.28 times as wide as Jupiter, circling a Sun-like star every four days. Here it is a sphere of that size glowing at its measured dayside heat.

thermal.title: Dayside heat
thermal.summary: The colour of a black body at the 1,213 K day side measured in eclipse.
